title: Ferrofluid Electromagnetic Sculpture
summary: An interactive Three.js and WebGL2 SDF sculpture of black ferrofluid pulsing with magnetic cusps and corona discharges inside eight copper coils.
description: An interactive Three.js instrument and 30-second film, Ferrofluid Symphony. Eight copper electromagnets surround a pool of black ferrofluid beneath a ceiling return coil while a 140 BPM score drives real-time SDF magnetic cusps, levitating droplets, and corona discharges.
